Simple purées

Apple purée

Almapüré

6 months+ Adjusted 20 min 4 portions

Serve the cooked purée on a spoon. Raw grated apple waits until chewing is reliable.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 320 g apples (prepared weight, peeled and cored)
  • 3 tbsp water (for the pan, plus a spoon more if the blend is thick)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the apples, cut out the cores, and slice the flesh.
  2. Cook in a small splash of water until completely soft, about 10 minutes.
  3. Blend until smooth.
  4. Cool until just warm.
  5. Do not add sugar.

Adjusted

Raw grated apple is a poor first texture. Sugar is often added, and the apple does not need it.

Cook the apple until soft and blend it smooth, with no sugar. Save raw grated apple until the baby is chewing well.
